name: Thyme
description: A low-growing, mat-forming aromatic subshrub with tiny grey-green leaves and clusters of small pale pink or white flowers.

img.alt: An illustration of a gently curved thyme sprig with short side branches and small paired green leaves
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Plant in a bright, fully exposed, and sunny location.
Use light, sandy, or rocky well-drained soil.
Avoid overwatering or damp conditions during winter.
Trim lightly after flowering to keep the plant compact.
enjoy: Incorporate sprigs into soups and stews. Bees love its flowers.
Create a fragrant ground cover along pathways or garden edges.
Dry small bunches to use as a pantry staple all year round.
Watch bees flock to the tiny nectar-rich blossoms.
